hubDedupe.rule: docs/specs/phase4-generators.md section 13 item 13 — hubs whose member sets overlap at Jaccard >= 0.5 form complete-linkage groups; the largest member set survives and the others redirect to it

firstBatch.note: docs/specs/hubs.md section 4 asks for 20 target and 10 pathway hubs. The corpus holds 5 pathway hubs meeting section 1, so the batch takes every one of them and 23 target hubs to reach 30.

pathwayNamingRule.rule: docs/specs/phase4-generators.md section 7 — a stored Europe PMC sentence counts only when it names the page's display name or a recorded synonym

vocabulariesNotUsed.iuphar-ligand-class: the IUPHAR rows this corpus holds record a ligand action against one target (Inhibition, Antagonist, Agonist), not a class of compounds; grouping on them would put every inhibitor of anything in one hub
vocabulariesNotUsed.chebi-has-role: CHEBI roles recorded here are chemical and organism roles (Homo sapiens metabolite, environmental contaminants), not a pharmacologic class
